name: Rental Desk
tagline: Back-office helper for small landlords: listings, inquiries, showings and rent logs
description: Keeps the paperwork side of a small rental portfolio moving. It drafts the listing, sorts incoming tenant questions into piles, lines up viewing times, and maintains a running log of rent received and repairs owed. Every item arrives as a draft, so nothing goes out until you look at it.
author: BrandenSeth
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
